title: Private deployment migration playbook — customer migration checklist, release orchestration, and post-launch telemetry
creator: Asha Patel
description: Create a reproducible migration playbook and orchestration checklist for customers adopting Private/VPC/on-prem features (RBAC, audit logs, KMS). Deliverables: customer migration checklist, launch runbook for cross-team engineers and support, templates for release notes, and a telemetry plan for post-launch quality monitoring.
background: We have a growing set of enterprise customers ready to move from hosted to Private deployments. Previous launches focused on feature parity but lacked a consolidated migration path and telemetry that ties security feature toggles (RBAC/KMS/audit) back to user experience and cost. This ticket consolidates PM-run orchestration tasks, produces customer-facing migration materials, and defines post-launch telemetry so we can detect regressions quickly.
goals: Provide a step-by-step migration checklist customers can run with SEs or do-self-serve
Deliver a cross-functional launch runbook covering infra, runtime, console, security, and support
Ship a release notes template and customer comms cadence aligned to sales/CS
Instrument post-launch telemetry and alerting to detect auth regressions or audit gaps within 48 hours of rollout
success_metrics: <50% customer support incidents related to RBAC/KMS within first 30 days
Telemetry coverage: 95% of migration flows produce audit log entries
Time-to-migrate (from plan kickoff to production cutover) median <= 7 days for pilot customers
Zero critical regressions requiring rollback for 90% of pilot migrations
acceptance_criteria: Customer-facing migration checklist published in Confluence and approved by Legal/Compliance
Cross-team runbook validated in a dry-run with Eng, SRE, SEs, and Support
Release notes template reviewed by Communications and Sales Engineering
Dashboards and alerts (console and internal Grafana) implemented and smoke-tested with synthetic traffic
rollout_steps: 1) Draft customer migration checklist and internal runbook (PM)
2) Security review + compliance signoff on KMS key handling and audit retention (Security & Legal)
4) Run an internal dry-run with a staging tenant following checklist (Eng + SE)
5) Pilot with 2 customers, capture feedback, iterate checklist and runbook (Customer Success)
6) Finalize release notes and customer comms; schedule SEP and webinar (Marketing & Sales)
7) Gradual rollout to remaining customers with canary telemetry and rollback plan (PM + Eng)
8) Post-launch retrospective and doc updates (All teams)
communications_plan: Internal: weekly sync 30m with Eng/SRE/SE/Support during pilot; escalation channel #private-migrate
External: customer pre-migration checklist email, migration week kickoff call, post-migration validation email
Marketing: one-page migration guide + webinar for customers in the pilot cohort
Sales: migration readiness badge and FAQ for AE enablement
risks: KMS integration edge cases cause delayed migrations (key rotation, external HSM configs)
RBAC policy misconfigurations lock out users — must validate dry-run and fallback admin path
Audit log volume spikes could increase storage/costs unexpectedly
Incomplete telemetry leaves regression blind spots during scale-up
mitigations: Pre-flight KMS compatibility matrix and sample Terraform modules for common cloud KMSs
Ensure a backdoor emergency admin key flow that is logged and time-limited
Set temporary ingestion caps and cost alerts tied to migration windows
Define minimum telemetry event set (auth, token issuance, audit write success/failure) and run synthetic checks
qa_checks: Dry-run migration using staging tenant and seed data
RBAC policy fuzz tests to exercise deny/allow paths
Audit log completeness checks against golden baseline
End-to-end KMS encrypt/decrypt verification across key rotation
release_notes_draft: Headline: Private Deployments — customer migration playbook, RBAC hardening, audit logs, and KMS guidance
Bullet 1: New migration checklist and runbook to help customers move to Private/VPC/on-prem safely
Bullet 2: Added telemetry and dashboards to monitor auth and audit integrity during migration
Bullet 3: Sample Terraform modules and configuration snippets for major KMS providers
open_questions: Do we require per-customer audit retention SLAs or rely on tiered defaults?
Which KMS providers must we ship first for GA (AWS KMS, GCP KMS, Azure Key Vault)?
Can we automate the majority of RBAC role mapping from hosted to private, or is manual mapping required?
